integrity: The stated formulas have a self-contained proof. The independent finite checker corroborates 42 bounded cases and does not stand in for infinite quantifier proof.
scientific_limitations: The m=3 parallelogram and its period-three formula are in the motivating paper and are not claimed new.
The result establishes a family with unbounded least quasiperiod but does not classify arbitrary lattice polygons.
Historical-priority risk remains for unindexed or inaccessible literature; no independent mathematical validation was performed.
title: Arbitrarily large least quasiperiods for lattice-diameter segments of primitive-edged parallelograms
